description: This file defines a Qwik component named NoteList, which renders a searchable, selectable list of notes. It manages internal signals for selected note ID and search query, and provides callback props for handling note creation, selection, and search changes via QRLs. The component also generates UI elements including a header, search input, and list of notes with interaction handlers.

methods.name: timeAgo
methods.description: Utility function that takes a timestamp and returns a human-readable string indicating how long ago that time was

methods.name: NoteList
methods.description: Qwik component that renders a list of notes with searchable and selectable features, accepting various callback props for parent communication
